I'm Tumelo Tshana Konaite, and I specialize in Data Science, AI Engineering, and Software Engineering. I hold an MSc in Computational and Applied Mathematics, with a focus on quantitative finance and interest rate modelling. Over the past 6 years, I’ve been involved in building data-driven products and machine learning solutions that solve real-world business problems.

My work primarily revolves around creating scalable and production-ready AI systems, utilizing technologies such as Python, SQL, AWS, and various machine learning frameworks. I have a particular interest in areas like Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), agentic AI systems, and backend engineering. 

I enjoy the challenge of designing and implementing systems that integrate data and AI, ultimately delivering measurable business value. In my free time, I also enjoy activities like hiking, fitness, and watching football.
